error.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot do this. Owners and admins manage studies and download exports.
error.STALE_REVISION: This study changed since you opened it. Refresh and try again.
error.STUDY_ALREADY_OPEN: This release already has a study in draft or recruiting. Close it before starting another.
error.STUDY_DEFINITION_LOCKED: Recruiting has started, so the arms, instruments and consent text can no longer change.
error.STUDY_NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft study can be opened.
error.STUDY_NOT_STARTED: There is nothing to export until the study opens.
error.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the fields: a title of 3+ characters, a purpose of 20+ characters, 2 to 6 arms with distinct ids and a minimum cell size of 3 to 100.
error.unavailable: Studies are unavailable right now. Nothing changed.
problem.STUDY_ITEM_UNKNOWN: An item is not in this release.
problem.STUDY_ITEM_IN_TWO_SETS: An item is in two sets; each set needs its own items.
problem.STUDY_ITEM_REPEATED: An item is listed twice in one set.
problem.STUDY_TRANSFER_ROLE: A transfer item has a different SDK role (only items marked transfer, or unmarked, qualify).
problem.STUDY_DELAYED_NOT_RETENTION: Delayed items must be the course's held-out retention items, so the retention schedule delivers them.
problem.STUDY_PRE_REQUIRED: Opening needs at least one pre-test item.
problem.STUDY_POST_REQUIRED: Opening needs at least one post-test item.
